entities.summary: Vladimir Viktorovich Ulanov was a Russian former volleyball player who competed for the Soviet Union in the 1976 Summer Olympics in Montreal. In 1976, Ulanov was part of the Soviet team that won the silver medal in the Olympic tournament. He played all five matches.
